tools.name: legislative_overview
tools.description: Start here. Tiny summary of the legislative workspace: whether the data feed is connected, how many bills are stored, how many states are covered, and how current the data is. Read-only. Call this before other legislative tools to know what's available.

tools.name: legislative_search_bills
tools.description: Search U.S. state and federal bills by keyword, returning compact rows (id, state, number, title, stage, last action). Use legislative_get_bill with a returned id for full detail. Read-only.

query.description: Keywords to search titles, summaries, and bill numbers.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g. "CA"), or "US" for Congress. Omit for all.

status.description: Filter to bills at this stage: introduced, engrossed, enrolled, passed, vetoed, failed, or unknown.

tools.name: legislative_get_bill
tools.description: Full detail for one bill: title, summary, stage, sponsors, subjects, progress timeline, companion/same-as bills, scheduled hearing events, and the list of available text documents. Use the returned document ids with legislative_get_bill_text. Read-only.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

refresh.description: Force a fresh read instead of serving the stored copy. Use sparingly.

tools.name: legislative_get_bill_text
tools.description: Full text of one bill version or amendment document, by document id from legislative_get_bill. Documents are immutable once published, so repeat reads are free. Long — summarize rather than echoing. Read-only.

docId.description: Document id from a bill's document list.

tools.name: legislative_get_votes
tools.description: Roll-call results for one bill: date, chamber, description, yea/nay/absent totals, and whether it passed. For who voted which way, pass a returned rollCallId to legislative_get_roll_call. Read-only.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

tools.name: legislative_get_roll_call
tools.description: Per-legislator breakdown for one roll call — how each member voted. Use only when the totals from legislative_get_votes are not enough. Read-only.

tools.name: legislative_get_amendments
tools.description: Amendments offered to one bill: chamber, date, title, description, and whether adopted. Amendment text is retrievable through legislative_get_bill_text where a document id exists. Read-only.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

tools.name: legislative_get_legislator
tools.description: Profile for one legislator (name, party, chamber role, district) plus the bills they sponsor within the tracked set. Read-only.

peopleId.description: Legislator id from a bill's sponsor list.

tools.name: legislative_get_hearing_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming committee hearings and scheduled events for stored bills, in date order. Coverage varies by legislature — some chambers publish hearing schedules sparsely, and this reflects what they publish rather than implying uniform coverage. Read-only.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g. "CA"), or "US" for Congress. Omit for all.

to.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days out).

tools.name: legislative_track_bill
tools.description: Add a bill to the user's tracked list, optionally with a position (support / oppose / monitor), a priority, tags, and an internal note. Idempotent — tracking an already-tracked bill updates whichever fields you pass. The bill must have been opened at least once.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

position.description: support, oppose, monitor, or none. Defaults to monitor.

priority.description: high, medium, or low. Defaults to medium.

tools.name: legislative_list_tracked
tools.description: The tracked-bill list with each bill's position, priority, tags, notes, and whether it has moved since the user last reviewed it. `changedCount` is the needs-attention number. Filter with position / priority / tag, or changedOnly to see just what moved. Read-only.

position.description: Filter: support, oppose, monitor, or none.

tag.description: Filter to bills carrying this tag.

changedOnly.description: Only bills that moved since the user last reviewed them.

tools.name: legislative_update_track
tools.description: Update the team-workflow fields on a tracked bill: position, priority, tags, notes. Pass markReviewed to clear its changed flag once the user has looked at what moved.

billId.description: Bill id of a tracked bill.

markReviewed.description: Mark reviewed as of now, clearing the changed flag.

tools.name: legislative_untrack_bill
tools.description: Remove a bill from the user's tracked list. Their notes and position for it are removed with it.

billId.description: Bill id of a tracked bill.

tools.name: legislative_create_alert
tools.description: Create an alert. An alert doubles as a saved search — the same query runs on a schedule. Types: keyword (new bills matching a phrase), bill_status (a bill changes stage), hearing_scheduled (a hearing is put on the calendar), and comment_deadline (a federal rulemaking comment window on the topic is closing soon — the one that comes with a deadline to act on). Alerts are checked on a schedule, so expect minutes-to-hours, not seconds.

name.description: What the user calls this alert.

query.description: Required for keyword alerts (the phrase to match) and comment_deadline alerts (the rulemaking topic to watch).

states.description: Two-letter state codes to limit to; omit for all. "US" is Congress.

filters.description: bill_status alerts: `statuses` limits which stages fire (omit for any change). comment_deadline alerts: `withinDays` is how far ahead to warn (default 30).

digestOptIn.description: Include in the weekly digest (default true).

tools.name: legislative_list_alerts
tools.description: The user's alert definitions, with type, scope, channels, and when each was last checked. Read-only.

tools.name: legislative_delete_alert
tools.description: Delete one alert definition. Alerts it already fired stay in the history.

tools.name: legislative_list_alert_events
tools.description: What the user's alerts have caught — the "what did I miss" list, newest first, with an unread count. Read-only.

unreadOnly.description: Only alerts not yet marked read.

tools.name: legislative_get_digest
tools.description: The user's current weekly summary: tracked bills that moved and alerts that fired over the last seven days. This is a preview — reading it sends nothing. Read-only.

tools.name: legislative_summarize_bill
tools.description: Plain-language summary of one bill: what it does, who it affects, where it stands, and what happens next. Grounded in the stored record — it says when something is not in the record rather than guessing. Reads stored data only.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

audience.description: Who the summary is for, e.g. "a hospital operations team". Shapes the framing.

tools.name: legislative_generate_memo
tools.description: Client-ready memo on one bill: bottom line, what it does, status and likely path, who is behind it, what it means for the reader, and next steps. Pass the reader's position to have it written to that position honestly — real risks are still named. Reads stored data only.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

audience.description: Who the memo is addressed to.

position.description: The reader's stance, e.g. "opposed — it raises their compliance cost".

tools.name: legislative_classify_bills
tools.description: Sort stored bills into the user's own issue areas, with a relevance rating and a one-line reason each. This is the 'only show me what is moving on my issues' filter. Bills that do not match come back as relevance 'none' rather than being stretched to fit. Reads stored data only.

tools.name: legislative_diff_bill_versions
tools.description: Compare two versions of a bill and explain what changed — the 'what is in the substitute' question. Returns a real line-level redline computed from the stored documents plus a plain-language read of the substantive changes. Both versions must have been retrieved first via legislative_get_bill_text. Reads stored data only.

fromDocId.description: Document id of the earlier version.

toDocId.description: Document id of the later version.

tools.name: legislative_export_report
tools.description: Build a client-ready report of the user's tracked bills, grouped by position (supporting / opposing / monitoring) and ordered by priority, with bills that moved since last review called out. Returns the report as markdown. Optionally emails it — the report comes back either way, so a delivery problem never loses it. Reads stored data only.

title.description: Report title. Defaults to a generic tracking-report title.

state.description: Limit to one state, e.g. "NV". Omit for all.

position.description: Limit to support, oppose, monitor, or none.

priority.description: Limit to high, medium, or low.

tag.description: Limit to bills carrying this tag.

changedOnly.description: Only bills that moved since last review — the 'what changed this week' report.

includeNarrative.description: Include a short written overview at the top (default true).

email.description: Send the report to this address. Delivery is restricted to approved recipients.

tools.name: legislative_remember_issue_profile
tools.description: Record what this user or team works on legislatively — an issue area, why it matters, the jurisdictions involved, their default stance, and the phrases that signal a bill touches it. Recalled on later turns so the user does not have to restate it, and used to judge which bills are worth surfacing. Saving the same issue name again replaces the previous version.

description.description: What matters about it, in the user's own framing.

defaultPosition.description: The team's usual stance here: support, oppose, monitor, or none.

keywords.description: Phrases that indicate a bill touches this issue.

tools.name: legislative_forget_issue_profile
tools.description: Remove a recorded issue profile by name. Tracked bills and alerts are unaffected.

tools.name: legislative_build_dashboard
tools.description: Build a visual tracking dashboard of the user's bill book: what moved since they last looked, position and stage breakdowns, and their upcoming hearings. Returns a ready-to-render widget layout — pass the widgets straight through to the canvas rather than describing them in prose. Deterministic, so the same book always lays out the same way. Reads stored data only.

state.description: Limit to one state, e.g. "NV". Omit for all.

tools.name: legislative_search_federal_rules
tools.description: Search federal rules, proposed rules, and notices — the regulatory half of what affects a client, which legislation alone misses. Returns title, agency, publication date, when comments close, and when it takes effect. Pass documentNumber for one specific document. Read-only.

query.description: Keywords to search rule titles and abstracts.

agency.description: Agency slug to limit to, e.g. "environmental-protection-agency".

type.description: RULE (final), PRORULE (proposed — the one with a comment window), or NOTICE. Omit for all.

documentNumber.description: Fetch one document by its number instead of searching.

tools.name: legislative_list_comment_deadlines
tools.description: Open federal rulemaking dockets with the comment deadline resolved — how many days are left to file. This is the actionable one: a rule found after comments closed is trivia, one found with three weeks left is work. Defaults to open windows only. Read-only.

includeClosed.description: Also return dockets whose comment window has already closed.

tools.name: legislative_get_federal_hearings
tools.description: Published congressional hearing records for a Congress, with links to transcripts where they exist. Transcripts are published weeks to months after the hearing itself — say so rather than implying live coverage. For state hearing schedules use legislative_get_hearing_calendar. Read-only.

tools.name: legislative_search_congressional_record
tools.description: Recent daily Congressional Record issues — the published record of floor proceedings, newest first, with links to each issue. Use for what was actually said and done on the floor. Read-only.

tools.name: legislative_find_similar_bills
tools.description: Find bills in other states that closely resemble this one — the model-legislation signal. When the same bill is run in eight states it is numbered and titled differently in each, so keyword search never connects them. Same-state matches are excluded by default because they are usually companions or re-filings rather than the copied-across-states pattern. Read-only.

billId.description: Bill id from a search result.

includeSameState.description: Also return bills from the same state (companions and re-filings).

tools.name: legislative_list_tracked_bill_record
tools.description: List stored tracked_bill records for legislative. Optional filters match indexed lookup fields from the manifest.

tools.name: legislative_read_tracked_bill_record
tools.description: Read a stored tracked_bill record for legislative by record id. Returns field values shaped from the vertical manifest.

tools.name: legislative_write_tracked_bill_record
tools.description: Create or update a stored tracked_bill record for legislative by subjectRef. Field keys use manifest source keys with sourced or missing fact shapes.
